qa_pairs.question: What part number is specified for removing and installing the shift lever on all wheel drive vehicles?
qa_pairs.answer: Part number 25 11 000 is specified for removing and installing the shift lever on all wheel drive vehicles.

qa_pairs.question: Which special tools are mentioned for loosening the threaded sleeve?
qa_pairs.answer: Special Tool 26 1 060 or 26 1 040 are mentioned for loosening the threaded sleeve several turns.

qa_pairs.question: What should be removed before starting the shift lever removal procedure?
qa_pairs.answer: Remove exhaust assembly 18 00 020 and unscrew heat shields before starting the shift lever removal procedure.

qa_pairs.question: What are the three numbered components shown in the middle right diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The three numbered components are: (1) lift out circlip, (2) take off washer, and (3) pull out selector rod.

qa_pairs.question: What special tool is required to remove the shift lever from above?
qa_pairs.answer: Special Tool 25 1 100 is required to remove the shift lever from above.

qa_pairs.question: How should Special Tool 25 1 100 be positioned when removing the shift lever?
qa_pairs.answer: Apply Special Tool 25 1 100, turn counterclockwise 90°, push up spherical plate, then remove shift lever from above.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done with the transmission during the removal procedure?
qa_pairs.answer: Support the transmission, unscrew cross member, and lower transmission to front axle carrier.

qa_pairs.question: What inspection should be performed during installation?
qa_pairs.answer: Check length of bolts during installation.

qa_pairs.question: What components need to be disconnected related to the backup lights?
qa_pairs.answer: Disconnect plug on wires for backup lights as part of the removal procedure.

qa_pairs.question: What should be checked regarding the dust covers during installation?
qa_pairs.answer: Inspect dust covers and check for correct seating during installation.

qa_pairs.question: What torque specification is mentioned for the threaded sleeve?
qa_pairs.answer: Tightening torque is specified for the threaded sleeve when using Special Tool 26 1 060 or 26 1 040 after finishing installation.

qa_pairs.question: What dust covers are mentioned in the removal procedure?
qa_pairs.answer: Two dust covers are mentioned: lift out dust cover, and disconnect dust cover (2) on shift console, with instructions to undo dust cover (1) on body and pull off shift lever.
